note: Mail capture scope (ING-06; one mail store, integrations/capture_mail): the Workbench reads every mailbox of the tenant directory and keeps what it captures in its own capture store under the Workbench state directory, never in Git, logs or source records. all_mailboxes lists every member user with a mail address through the guarded, paged /users GET at the start of each run; every folder of each mailbox is captured (folders all: the folder listing is read when a run opens the mailbox, again after six hours) and each folder keeps its own delta cursor, so a mailbox new in the directory starts its first round (90-day window) while the others resume from their delta links; history all: once a folder's windowed round is current, its older mail is read newest first by its own cursor until the whole folder is held. A run gives every folder a turn of a few pages before any folder gets a second one, so the newest mail of every mailbox arrives first. exclude is the explicit exclusion list (address or object id, with the reason); an excluded mailbox's mail is never requested. A mailbox Graph refuses (HTTP 403, e.g. outside the Exchange application access policy) is a bound, incomplete gap with reason forbidden, never dropped. Capturing grants nothing: every reader is re-gated per mailbox (live-source audience, mailbox owner ACL, employee gate) whenever results are viewed.
